proposal.summary: SAUTER Controls Nova 200–220 Series with firmware version 3.3-006 and prior and BACnetstac version 4.2.1 and prior have only FTP and Telnet available for device management, leading to sensitive information being sent in cleartext.
proposal.affected_product: SAUTER Controls Nova 200–220 Series with firmware version 3.3-006 and prior and BACnetstac version 4.2.1 and prior
proposal.cwe_quote: The product transmits sensitive information in cleartext, which can be intercepted by an attacker.

AV.quote: An attacker could obtain sensitive information such as user credentials to gain access to the system.

C.quote: Any sensitive information communicated through these protocols, such as credentials, is sent in cleartext.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Evaluate the use of secure protocols for device management to protect sensitive information.

evidence_quotes.claim: Sensitive information is sent in cleartext.
evidence_quotes.quote: Any sensitive information communicated through these protocols, such as credentials, is sent in cleartext.

evidence_quotes.claim: An attacker could obtain sensitive information.
evidence_quotes.quote: An attacker could obtain sensitive information such as user credentials to gain access to the system.
